summary.headline: Judgments on Parents’ Fortune
summary.text: Astrological judgments on the parents’ status and fortune in a nativity: Venus, the Moon, benefics, and malefics indicate maternal exaltation or parental servitude, fall, and poverty, while the Sun, Saturn, domicile and triplicity lords, the part of the father, and the part of fortune signify paternal dignity, wealth, durable fortune, and inheritance.
